_comment: Config for the kanban-cycle skill, read at the start of every cycle. To reuse this automation on another project: copy the .claude/skills/kanban-cycle folder there and write a new file like this one pointing at that project's repo/board.
_comment_cost_ceiling: orchestrator_cost_ceiling_usd thresholds get_session's external_metadata.usage.cost_usd, which values the session's tokens at API list prices. On a subscription plan that is NOT a bill — it is just a convenient running total of token volume, and the real constraint is the rate-limit window (see rate_limit_info in the same response). Tune this by how long you want one orchestrator generation to live, not by a spend budget.
_comment_orchestrator_branch: The branch carrying the current .claude/skills. A new session clones the repo's DEFAULT branch unless told otherwise, so /handoff must check this out explicitly or the successor comes up without the skills that define its own job. Fixed to main at generation 4's handoff (2026-08-31), 3 generations after this was first flagged wrong — main now carries the current skill files (verified via git ls-tree before making this change). If this ever needs to point elsewhere again, that's a regression to investigate, not a new normal.
_comment_maintenance_automerge_paths: Vinnie's standing instruction, 2026-09-03: a maintenance PR (no linked Notion ticket) whose entire diff falls within these paths may merge on green CI alone, without waiting for his review/lgtm first — see kanban-cycle SKILL.md step 3. Deliberately narrow: the orchestrator's own skill/config files only, never app code, migrations, or anything that changes runtime behavior. Widening this list is a decision for Vinnie to make explicitly, not one for a cycle to infer.
